entries.title: AP three-way match on a public benchmark, run 1 (blind by the authors' records only)

run.id: AP run 1, blind by the authors' records only (UTC file times: benchmark data on disk 12:33:54; prereg created 12:47:22; run 1's results written 12:49:17; frozen checker file written 12:49:55, after the results; the FREEZE line inside a prereg whose sha256 was never recorded is the only record that the checker was frozen first)

entries.why_not_a_table: No sha256 of its prereg was recorded before the run, so verify bench emit refuses it (see the refused list). No hash is taken now, on purpose: it would prove the text from today on, never that it came before the run.
entries.headline: on a synthetic, templated 100-case benchmark, 0 wrong of 82 decided (Wilson 95% upper bound ≈ 4.5%) at 82% coverage

rows.claim: run 1: wrong decisions among the invoices it decided
rows.note: descriptive: no preregistered bar; Distil Labs' public benchmark: synthetic, templated invoices from one source

rows.claim: run 1: coverage, invoices decided rather than sent to a person
rows.note: descriptive: no preregistered bar; the other 18 went to a person

rows.claim: run 1: should-pay invoices sent to a person
rows.note: descriptive: no preregistered bar; the delay cost on good bills; the other 5 abstentions were hold_total cases

rows.claim: audit: published wrong model decisions routed to a person
rows.note: descriptive: no preregistered bar; a consequence of the run 1 row, not separate evidence; seven published configurations over the same 100 invoices

rows.claim: audit: of those, routed because the checker decided and disagreed
rows.note: descriptive: no preregistered bar; the other 24 went to a person only because the checker abstained

rows.claim: audit: wrong auto-executions among auto-executed decisions
rows.note: descriptive: no preregistered bar; follows from the run 1 row; the seven configurations share the same 100 invoices, so these are not independent trials

rows.claim: stress, five fixed seeds (named holdout1 to holdout5): wrong decisions among the decided
rows.note: descriptive: no preregistered bar; 30 correlated perturbations of the same 100 cases, generated by the parser's authors, not unseen data; the parser was hardened on four earlier seeds; the interval assumes independent trials, which these are not; re-banked thirteen times (four times on 2026-10-05; at 00:18Z on 2026-10-06, and at 06:07Z, 08:35Z and 11:45Z that day, digest only; three times on 2026-10-13, under engine 0.7.0, then digest only, then for the engine 0.7.1 label only; twice on 2026-10-14, under engine 0.7.2 and ap-threeway@0.3.0, then digest only) under a pack that kept changing after the seeds first ran; every banked decision and count unchanged; the 00:18Z re-bank followed a change to the vendor check made with these seeds' results in view, and the first 2026-10-13 re-bank followed corrections to the AP pack's readings made after a first run on these seeds moved 120 decisions (5 of them wrong), so they are fixed seeds, not a holdout (bench/ap-blind/STRESS-AMENDMENT-2026-10-05.md)

rows.claim: stress, five fixed seeds (named holdout1 to holdout5): coverage
rows.note: descriptive: no preregistered bar; perturbed invoices decided rather than sent to a person; re-banked thirteen times (four times on 2026-10-05; at 00:18Z on 2026-10-06, and at 06:07Z, 08:35Z and 11:45Z that day, digest only; three times on 2026-10-13, under engine 0.7.0, then digest only, then for the engine 0.7.1 label only; twice on 2026-10-14, under engine 0.7.2 and ap-threeway@0.3.0, then digest only) under a pack that kept changing after the seeds first ran; every banked decision and count unchanged; the 00:18Z re-bank followed a change to the vendor check made with these seeds' results in view, and the first 2026-10-13 re-bank followed corrections to the AP pack's readings made after a first run on these seeds moved 120 decisions (5 of them wrong), so they are fixed seeds, not a holdout (bench/ap-blind/STRESS-AMENDMENT-2026-10-05.md)
